# Lint rules

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/lintdoc > docs/lint-rules.md`. Do not edit. -->

mcpDeck checks every tool when it is saved, in the editor as you type, with
`mcpdeck lint <toolkit>` and with the admin MCP `lint` tool. The checks are plain
code in `internal/lint`; no model runs, so the same input gives the same findings.

| Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|
| block | Invalid by the MCP spec, a leaked credential, or a write tool marked read-only. Saving is refused. |
| warn | Works, but costs tokens or makes agents pick the wrong tool. Shown, and fails `mcpdeck lint --strict`. |
| hint | Usually helps. Shown only. |

Each finding carries the rule, a short explanation, a fix and the source below.
A toolkit's score starts at 100 and loses 25 per block and 5 per warning.

## Valid and safe

| Rule | Severity | Check | Fix | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema-valid` | block | inputSchema is an object with type "object"; properties is an object; required lists existing properties; types and enums are well formed. | Use { type: "object", properties: {...}, required: [...] }. | [mcp-tools](#sources) |
| `secret-in-definition` | block | Bearer tokens, AWS, GitHub, Slack and OpenAI-style keys, JWTs and private keys in the definition or code. | Store it as a secret variable on the application and use {{name}} or the application's auth. | [cwe-798](#sources), [mcp-security](#sources) |
| `secret-input` | block | Input parameters named password, secret, api_key, access_token, client_secret, private_key and similar. | Set the application's auth (login steps, OAuth, API key) so mcpDeck adds credentials; agents never see them. | [mcp-security](#sources) |
| `credential-in-output` | block | Output fields named like credentials (password, access_token, api_key, cookie…) with a value. | Use credentials inside the tool only, or set the application's auth. | [mcp-tools](#sources), [mcp-security](#sources) |
| `write-annotation` | block | A tool that calls a write request declares readOnlyHint: true, or calls DELETE and declares destructiveHint: false. | Remove the hint; mcpDeck sets readOnlyHint and destructiveHint from the requests the tool calls. | [mcp-schema](#sources), [mcp-tools](#sources) |
| `name-format` | warn | Name length and characters. | Rename to snake_case, for example list_findings. | [mcp-tools](#sources) |

## Tools for tasks, not endpoints

| Rule | Severity | Check | Fix | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint-wrappers` | warn | 80% or more of a toolkit's tools (5 or more) call one request each. | Chain the requests in one tool and return the answer. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `overlap` | warn | Two tools call the same set of requests, or have near-identical descriptions. | Merge them, with an input that selects the variant. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `catch-all` | warn | Inputs named method with path, url or endpoint. | Write one tool per task. Agents with build access already have search and execute for exploring. | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [cloudflare-code-mode](#sources) |
| `tool-count` | warn | Warn over 15 tools in one toolkit. | Split toolkits by task, or merge tools that are steps of one job. | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [anthropic-code](#sources) |
| `list-tokens` | warn | Warn over 4,000 tokens for a toolkit's tools/list. | Shorten descriptions and schemas, drop unused tools, or split the toolkit. | [anthropic-code](#sources) |
| `tool-tokens` | warn | One tool's definition over 800 tokens. | Move detail into short parameter descriptions; drop long examples. | [anthropic-code](#sources) |

## Names and descriptions

| Rule | Severity | Check | Fix | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | warn | Generic names (new_tool, get_data, run…) warn; one-word names get a hint. | Name it verb_object after the job: find_vulnerabilities, get_customer_summary. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `description` | warn | Empty, starter text left in, under 25 characters, or over 1,024 characters. | Say what it returns and what it needs, in one or two sentences. | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [mcp-tools](#sources) |
| `use-when` | hint | Toolkits with 4 or more tools: a tool has no useWhen. | Add useWhen: the question this tool answers. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `write-guard` | warn | A write tool without dontUseWhen. | Add dontUseWhen, for example "just looking something up". | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [mcp-tools](#sources) |
| `actionable-errors` | hint | throw new Error(...) with a message under 20 characters or a bare "error", "failed", "invalid". | Say what was wrong and what input would work, for example "No image named x; call list_images for names". | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [mcp-tools](#sources) |

## Inputs agents can fill

| Rule | Severity | Check | Fix | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `param-name` | warn | Parameters named id, name, q, data, value, type, obj, input. | Use a specific name such as user_id. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `param-docs` | hint | Parameters with no description and no enum. | Add a description to each parameter. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `enum` | hint | String parameters named status, state, sort, order, format, severity, priority or kind without enum. | Add enum: [...] with the accepted values. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `required` | warn | Parameters exist but none are required. | List the parameters the tool can't work without in required. | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [mcp-tools](#sources) |
| `params` | warn | More than 8 parameters. | Bind fixed values as toolkit variables; keep inputs to what changes per question. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `no-params` | hint | No properties and additionalProperties not false. | Use { type: "object", additionalProperties: false }. | [mcp-tools](#sources) |

## Return only what the task needs

| Rule | Severity | Check | Fix | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pagination` | hint | Code that maps or filters a list, with no limit, page, cursor or first input and no slice. | Add a limit input with a small default and return a hint when there is more. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `raw-return` | warn | return res; with no pick(...). | Return only the fields the task needs with pick(res, [...]). | [anthropic-tools](#sources), [anthropic-code](#sources) |
| `output-tokens` | warn | Warn over 2,000 tokens in a test or run. | Drop fields, summarise lists, add a limit. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `field-count` | warn | More than 25 leaf fields in an output. | Return pick(res, [...]) with the fields the task needs. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `unbounded-list` | warn | A list of more than 50 items in an output. | Add a limit input, filter by what the agent asked, or return counts. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `blob` | warn | Strings of 200+ base64 characters. | Leave them out, or return a short reference. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `deep-nesting` | hint | Nested more than 4 levels. | Flatten to the fields the agent uses. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `empty-fields` | hint | Fields that are null or empty in every item. | Drop them. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `long-text` | hint | Strings over 2,000 characters. | Return a summary, with a separate tool for the full text. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
| `opaque-ids` | hint | Three or more fields holding UUIDs. | Return names alongside IDs; keep only IDs another tool needs. | [anthropic-tools](#sources) |
